profile.subtitleJa: ケトラの子として記される人物
profile.summaryJa: アブラハムの側室ケトラが産んだ子らの一人として、ジムラン、ヨクシャンらとともに名が挙がります。

wikipedia.title: Shuah
wikipedia.noteJa: 同じ綴りで複数の人物を扱う記事ですが、創世記25章の項はアブラハムとケトラの子を記し、歴代誌上1:32も参照しています。

sources.title: World English Bible · 1CH 1:32
sources.attribution: World English Bible (WEB), public domain; fixed local witness webp-usfx-2026-10-13-35a6adf626e5.

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

wikipediaCheck.identityBasisJa: The article separates several names transliterated “Shuah” and its Genesis 25 entry identifies Abraham and Keturah’s son, with a citation to 1 Chronicles 1:32. This supports the genealogical figure in this verse; other Shuah-named figures on the same page are distinct.
wikipediaCheck.evidenceLocator: “Genesis 25” section, lines 113–120: set-index introduction distinguishes several Hebrew names sharing the KJV transliteration; this section identifies Shuah as a son of Abraham and Keturah and reference 4 cites 1 Chronicles 1:32.
